notes.title: 2021.11.11 update
notes.content: Optimize the performance of some effects

notes.title: The second public beta of "Ball Heroes" opens, and the 10v10 fierce battle!
notes.content:
1. Test details:

This test will last for two weeks from November 10 to November 25, when 500 player accounts will be opened!

2. Major version update

*Add 10v10 battle mode

*Add accompanying robot

*Improve the algorithm of general attack ball strength, which is determined according to the distance

*Passing increases the cooldown

*Fixed the problem that some characters did not move and some characters did not display the model when the game was restarted

*Adjust scoring rules to increase goals and player kill scores

*Novice guidance adjustment

*Who is the MVP of the game has been added to the battle settlement page

*Increase the camera vibration effect and decrease according to the distance

*Add shortcut keys for player name hiding

*In the login interface, you can set and change the password when creating a room

*Add the function of placing the mouse in the middle of the screen when Right mouse button sliding

*Fixed a bug where the robot had no damage effects

*Fixed the bug that the player could not revive after the end of the cross game death action

notes.title: 2021.12.08更新
notes.content:
补丁说明：
* 增加10V10对战模式
* 添加陪玩机器人
* 调整普攻根据距离来确定击球力度
* 传球增加了冷却时间
* 修正重新开始比赛时有角色不动、有角色不显示模型
* 调整得分规则，增加进球和玩家击杀得分
* 新手引导调整
* 战斗结算页面增加了谁是比赛 MVP 的内容
* 增加相机震动效果据距离递减
* 增加玩家名字隐藏的快捷键
* 登录界面中，创建房间可以设置、更改密码的功能
* 增加右键滑动时，鼠标放到屏幕中间的功能
* 修正机器人没有伤害特效的bug
* 修正跨球局死亡动作结束，导致玩家不能复活的bug
